body:
## What happened

`fea5b0e48 Update translations [skip ci]` was HEAD of main on 2026-08-09 and main
was red on it. Because the commit carries `[skip ci]`, no workflow ran, so
`gh run list --branch main` reported the previous commit's SUCCESS. Main read
green while every PR branched from it inherited a red Fast Tests.

The workflow justifies the skip with "The commit holds only generated files"
(.github/workflows/update-translations.yml). That is the flawed premise: the
generated `.po` catalogs are exactly what the i18n gates assert on, so a
generated-only commit is precisely the kind that can red main.

## Chain

1. `extract_spa_strings.py --write` regenerated the AUTOGEN block and dropped 31
   hand-added anchors that lived inside it (F-83cd73).
2. The next Update Translations run extracted a .pot without them, and msgmerge
   moved their entries to obsolete `#~` in all 28 locales.
3. fr and nl lost 23 SPA interface strings; `test_api_v1_i18n` went red on main.
4. `[skip ci]` meant nothing reported it. Discovered only because a later PR
   inherited the failure.

## The cheap guard does NOT work — measured, do not ship it

The obvious fix is a pre-commit gate in the same job. `test_615`'s
`test_completed_locale_spa_chrome_is_fully_translated` runs on the job's existing
deps (Babel/polib/jinja2) plus pytest with `--noconftest`, in 0.74s. Tempting.

It does not catch this. Run against the real offending tree (`git worktree add
--detach /tmp/wt fea5b0e48`), that test **passes**. Dropping the anchors shrank
the SPA-chrome catalog, so completeness was trivially satisfied — the gate is
blind to the very deletion that caused the damage.

The test that did catch it is
`test_api_v1_i18n::test_reviewed_new_ui_translations_survive_runtime_fuzzy_filter`,
which pins an explicit reviewed-msgid list and so notices removal. It imports
flask, so it needs a real app environment, not the four-package job.

## Options

- Drop `[skip ci]` from the translation commit so the normal Test Suite runs on
  it. One line, no new deps. Cost is a full suite run per translation commit.
- Or install the app deps in the update-translations job and run the i18n gates
  (including `test_api_v1_i18n`) before committing, failing the job instead of
  pushing a red main.

Either is a deliberate CI change and wants its own pass. What must not happen is
shipping the 0.74s guard above and believing it covers this.
title: Update Translations commits [skip ci], so a generated .po change can red main with zero CI signal
